subject.title: Anthropic setup-token onboarding path has multiple failure modes (docs gap, credential propagation, multi-agent sync)

question: Should Anthropic setup-token/static-token auth be physically synced to sibling agent SQLite stores, inherited through runtime read-through only, or exposed through an explicit operator-controlled doctor/models-auth repair action?
rationale: The remaining fix changes how provider credentials move across agent-scoped stores, and prior same-root PRs were closed after credential-propagation security concerns.

options.title: Operator-Controlled Sync
options.body: Add a visible doctor or models-auth repair/sync command that validates the stored profile and copies only credentials the portability policy marks safe.

options.title: Runtime Inheritance Only
options.body: Keep per-agent stores untouched and improve setup-token guidance plus diagnostics around inherited main profiles.

options.title: Automatic Sibling Fan-Out
options.body: Write setup-token results to all configured agents during onboarding, accepting the broader credential-propagation risk after security review.

recommendation.title: Operator-Controlled Sync
recommendation.body: Add a visible doctor or models-auth repair/sync command that validates the stored profile and copies only credentials the portability policy marks safe.

likelyOwner.reason: They most recently touched provider-auth/Anthropic setup surfaces and previously flagged auth-file security concerns on the same cluster.
